description:
Are you an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal looking for a role where you can take ownership of your own caseload, work alongside highly regarded lawyers and have a clear opportunity to progress your career?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established, Legal 500-recognised Commercial Property team, based in either Worthing or Chichester.
